veg.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead, turn out and reheat sliced

steps.text: Make a dough with the flour and eggs, knead and rest.

Fry the diced eggplant in a third of the olive oil until golden and set aside. Fry the onion and mushrooms in the rest of the oil until browned, add the lentils and passata and simmer to a thick ragù.
Roll the dough thin and line a buttered ovenproof bowl.
Toss the cooked ziti with the ragù and layer in the bowl with the eggplant, boiled egg and provolone.
Fold the dough over and bake at 180C for 1 hour.
Rest for 30 minutes, turn out and slice.

veg.n: Big Night whole roast stuffed pumpkin
veg.make_ahead: Stuff and tie the pumpkin up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Halve the pumpkin lengthways, scoop out the seeds and hollow out a little more of the flesh. Score the cut faces.
Mix the fennel seeds, crushed garlic, chopped rosemary, breadcrumbs, grated cheese and half the olive oil and pack into both hollows.
Press the halves back together, tie with string every 5cm and rub the skin with the rest of the oil and the salt.
Roast at 200C for 1 and a half hours until a skewer slides through easily and the skin is blistered.
Rest for 10 minutes, cut off the string and carve into thick rounds.

veg.make_ahead: Best served warm

steps.text: Toss the mushrooms and capsicum with the oil, smoked paprika and cumin and grill until charred.
Cook the rice.
Fill the tortillas with the mushrooms, capsicum, rice, beans, cheddar, salsa and sour cream.
Roll tight and toast in a dry pan.
Toss the sweet potato in the oil and roast at 200C until tender.
Simmer the sweet potato and black beans in some of the sauce.
Fill the warmed tortillas with the sweet potato mix and cheddar, roll and lay in a baking dish.
Pour over the remaining sauce and top with cheddar.
Bake at 190C.
Scatter with coriander.
Brown the plant-based mince with the onion in half the oil.
Add the chilli powder, cumin, tomatoes and water, simmer until thick and season with half the salt.
Mash the black beans with the breadcrumbs, egg and the rest of the salt, shape into four patties and chill for 10 minutes.
Fry the patties in the rest of the oil over medium-high heat until crusted and hot through, and top with cheddar to melt.
Toast the buns and fill with the patties, chilli and jalapenos.
Put the hot sauce on the table for anyone wanting the extra-hot version.
Dice the onion and portion the plant-based mince into eight balls.
Oil a smoking griddle, smash the balls into thin patties, salt and flip at 90 seconds, adding the cheese.
Toast the buns.
Stack two patties per bun with onion, pickles, mustard and tomato sauce.

veg.n: Minnesota mushroom and tater tot hotdish
veg.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Fry the onion and mushrooms in the oil until well browned.
Stir in the lentils, soy sauce and cream and simmer until thick.
Tip into a dish and cover with tater tots and cheddar.
Bake at 200C until crisp.

veg.n: Wall of Gaylord mojo roast cauliflower
veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day in the fridge

steps.text: Blitz the garlic, orange and lime juice, two teaspoons of the cumin, the oregano, oil and salt. Sit the cauliflowers in a roasting dish and spoon the mojo over and into the florets.
Marinate in the fridge for 2 hours.
Roast covered at 200C for 40 minutes, then uncovered for 30 minutes, basting with the juices, until charred and tender.
Fry the onion and capsicum, add the beans and remaining cumin and simmer.
Cook the rice. Fry the banana slices in the butter.
Cut the cauliflowers into thick wedges, spoon over the pan juices and serve with the beans, rice and bananas.
Pat the tofu dry, cut into four thick slabs and salt. Crush the garlic, chop the chilli and dice the tomatoes.
Sear the tofu in half the oil until golden on both sides and set aside.
Soften the garlic and chilli in the rest of the oil, add the tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer.
Return the tofu and simmer gently.
Cook the jasmine rice.
Squeeze in lime and serve over the rice.

ingredients.item: heads cauliflower, cut into 4 thick steaks

steps.text: Season the cauliflower steaks with the salt, dust in flour and brown on both sides in the oil.
Make a dark roux with the butter and flour.
Add the onions, then the stock and thyme.
Lay the steaks in the gravy, cover and simmer gently until tender.
Cook the rice and serve the steaks over it with the gravy.
Boil the potatoes until tender, crush lightly and season with salt.
Pan-fry the haloumi in the oil until golden on both sides.
Add the butter, lemon juice and capers to the pan.
Spoon over the haloumi and serve with the potatoes.

veg.n: Mr Tuttle's garden potatoes and golden eggplant

steps.text: Boil the potatoes with the mint until tender and toss in some of the butter and a pinch of the salt.
Slice the eggplants into 2cm rounds, sprinkle with the rest of the salt and dust in flour.
Pan-fry the eggplant in the oil until golden outside and soft through.
Brown the rest of the butter, add the capers and lemon juice, and spoon over the eggplant.

veg.n: Weight room portobello steaks with garlic butter

steps.text: Toss the potatoes in three tablespoons of the oil and the salt.
Roast at 220C until crisp.
Mash the soft butter with garlic and parsley.
Brush the mushrooms with the rest of the oil and the soy sauce and grill over high heat until tender, turning once.
Blanch the beans and toss them with butter.
Top each pair of mushrooms with a slice of garlic butter.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Grate the beetroot and carrots, shred the cabbage and dice the potatoes.
Simmer all the vegetables in the stock until tender.
Add the vinegar and plenty of dill.
Serve with a big spoon of sour cream and rye bread.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, reheats well

steps.text: Rinse the barley and split peas and simmer in the stock and water.
Slice and dice the vegetables.
Add the vegetables and butter and simmer again until the barley and peas are soft.
Season well with salt and pepper and stir through the parsley.

veg.make_ahead: Onions and braising liquid up to 2 days ahead, braise the cauliflower fresh

steps.text: Rub the cauliflowers with the oil and salt and brown in a 220C oven.
Lay the onions in a roasting dish and sit the cauliflowers on top.
Mix the stock with the tomato paste, paprika and soy sauce, pour over, cover tightly and braise at 180C until tender.
Rest, slice thick and spoon over the onions and juices.

veg.n: Sweet and sour tofu with egg fried rice

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry, cut into chunks and coat in cornflour.
Fry in the oil in batches until crisp.
Simmer the rice vinegar, sugar and tomato sauce, add the pineapple and sliced capsicum.
Make egg fried rice from the cold rice and eggs with a spoon of the oil.
Toss the tofu through the sauce and serve with the rice.

veg.make_ahead: Soak up to 4 hours, fry fresh

ingredients.item: large cauliflower, cut into big florets

steps.text: Soak the cauliflower florets in the buttermilk in the fridge for 1 hour.
Dredge in seasoned flour and fry at 175C until crisp and tender.
Whisk a few spoonfuls of the hot oil with the cayenne, brown sugar and paprika and brush over the cauliflower.
Serve on white bread with pickles.

veg.make_ahead: Hummus up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Score the eggplants deeply and rub with the harissa, crushed garlic, cumin and oil.
Roast at 200C, covered for 30 minutes then uncovered for 30 minutes, until collapsing and soft.
Blitz the chickpeas with the tahini, a splash of water and salt into hummus.
Char the capsicums over a flame, peel and slice.
Blister the flatbreads in a hot pan, pull the eggplant apart and serve everything together.
Bake the frozen fries until crisp.
Cook the rice.
Sear the thickly sliced mushrooms in the oil in a smoking wok, add the sliced red onion and the tomatoes in wedges, then the soy and the vinegar.
Toss through the chips and serve with the rice.
Cut the tofu into thick slabs and lay over the ginger and half the spring onion on a plate.
Steam until hot through.
Cook the rice and steam the bok choy.
Top the tofu with fresh spring onion, pour over the soy, then smoking hot oil.

veg.make_ahead: Better the next day, keeps 3 days

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Soften the onion and carrots.
Add the wine, tomatoes, stock and rosemary, return the mushrooms with the lentils, cover and braise at 160C.
Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with butter.

veg_af.make_ahead: Better the next day, keeps 3 days

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Soften the onion and carrots.
Add the vinegar, tomatoes, stock and rosemary, return the mushrooms with the lentils, cover and braise at 160C.
Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with butter.
Cut the potatoes crinkle style and fry in the oil at 140C until soft, then drain.
Shape eight thin patties from the plant-based mince and slice the onion and pickles.
Smash the patties on a smoking oiled griddle and add the cheese.
Toast the buns and stack two patties per bun with onion and pickles.
Fry the chips again at 185C until crisp. Wrap one to take home.

veg.n: KTX to Busan kimchi fried rice (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Cook the rice a day ahead

steps.text: Cook the rice and let it go cold.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil with the smoked paprika until browned and crisp at the edges.
Add the kimchi and a splash of its juice.
Add the cold rice, gochujang and butter and press flat to crisp the bottom.
Top each bowl with a fried egg and torn nori.
Halve the mushrooms lengthways and score the cut sides.
Melt some of the butter with the garlic and lemon zest and brush over.
Grill cut side down, then flip and grill until golden and tender.
Boil the potatoes until tender and toss with the rest of the butter.
Serve with the salad leaves dressed with the oil and a squeeze of lemon, and lemon wedges.

ingredients.item: large cauliflowers, cut into 4 thick steaks

steps.text: Wrap half the garlic cloves, unpeeled, in foil and roast at 200C until soft.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter for mash and the squeezed roasted garlic.
Sear the cauliflower steaks in the oil until deep golden on both sides, add the butter and the rest of the garlic, crushed, baste well and finish in the oven for 10 minutes.
Steam the broccolini.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the plant-based mince with the onion and garlic in the oil.
Add the chilli powder, cumin, tomatoes, kidney beans and black beans.
Simmer until thick.
Serve with cheddar and corn chips.
Fry the mushrooms and onion in a little of the butter until dry and cool. Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk, then mash with the mushrooms, lentils, egg and allspice, roll into balls and chill.
Brown the meatballs gently in more of the butter.
Pour in the stock, soy sauce and cream and simmer gently until thick.
Boil the potatoes, mash with the rest of the butter and serve with lingonberry jam.

veg.n: Peruvian roast cauliflower with green sauce
veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day, roast fresh

steps.text: Toss the cauliflower wedges in the garlic, cumin, paprika, olive oil, salt and most of the lime juice.
Roast at 220C until charred and tender.
Blitz the coriander, jalapeno, mayonnaise and the rest of the lime juice for the sauce.
Fry the fries twice in the vegetable oil, first at a low heat then until crisp. Serve with the cauliflower.

veg.n: Loco moco, patties over rice with gravy (vegetarian)

steps.text: Shape the plant-based mince into patties and sear in the oil in a hot pan until crusted and hot through.
Cook the rice.
In the same pan, soften the onion in butter, stir in the flour and then the stock and soy until thick.
Fry the eggs. Serve the patties on rice with gravy and a fried egg.

ingredients.item: chopped dill pickles, plus slices to serve

steps.text: Slowly fry the onions in the butter until jammy.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, mustard and chopped pickles into a sauce.
Roll the plant-based mince into balls, smash flat in a very hot oiled pan, season and cook, then flip and add cheese.
Toast the buns and fill with sauce, patty, onions and pickles.

veg.make_ahead: Dough can be stretched 1 hour ahead

steps.text: Stretch the dough into two thin bases.
Spread with crushed tomatoes and top with mozzarella and plant-based pepperoni.
Bake on a hot steel at maximum heat.
Warm the honey with chilli flakes and drizzle over.

veg.make_ahead: Toppings can be prepped a day ahead

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms and capsicum and divide the dough into 4 balls.
Stretch each ball thin and top with sauce and mozzarella.
Top one pizza with plant-based pepperoni, one with mushrooms, one with pepperoni, mushroom and capsicum, and one with whatever vegetables are left in the fridge.
Bake each pizza on a preheated tray at the oven's highest setting until golden and bubbling, one or two at a time.

veg.n: Prancing Pony mushroom and ale pie
veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 2 days ahead, bake to serve

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil, then soften the onions with the thyme.
Add the ale, stock and soy sauce and simmer until rich and glossy.
Thicken with the flour, pour into a pie dish, top with pastry and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
Boil and mash the potatoes with the butter and cook the peas.

veg_af.make_ahead: Filling up to 2 days ahead, bake to serve

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil, then soften the onions with the thyme.
Add the stock, malt vinegar and soy sauce and simmer until rich and glossy.
Thicken with the flour, pour into a pie dish, top with pastry and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
Boil and mash the potatoes with the butter and cook the peas.

veg.n: Earp brothers' bean and mushroom chilli
veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, better the next day

steps.text: Soak the dried chillies in hot water, then blitz. Cut the mushrooms and sweet potato into chunks and dice the onion and garlic.
Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil.
Soften the onion and garlic, add the chillies, cumin and tomatoes.
Add the sweet potato, black beans, kidney beans, mushrooms, water and salt and simmer covered until thick. Serve with the cornbread.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Dice the mushrooms, onion and potatoes.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil with the smoked paprika until browned.
Soften the onion.
Add the potatoes, corn, thyme and stock and simmer.
Stir in the cream and blitz a little for body.
Serve topped with chives.

veg.n: Uncle Dave's theme park smoky mushroom legs
veg.make_ahead: Brine up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Dissolve the salt and sugar in the water with some of the paprika.
Brine the mushrooms for 1 hour.
Pat dry, push a skewer up through each stem and rub with the oil and the rest of the paprika.
Roast at 200C, turning once, until deeply browned and tender.

veg.make_ahead: Sauce up to 1 day, add tofu just before serving

steps.text: Cut the tofu into cubes and toss in the cornflour. Crush the garlic, grate the ginger and chop the chillies.
Fry the tofu in half the oil until golden and set aside.
Fry the garlic, ginger and chillies in the rest of the oil until fragrant.
Add the tomato sauce, sugar and water and simmer.
Return the tofu, swirl in the beaten eggs and serve with soft buns to mop up the sauce.
Stir the oil and flour over medium heat into a dark roux.
Dice the onion, celery and capsicum, slice the sausages and halve the mushrooms.
Add the vegetables and garlic to the roux, then the stock and smoked paprika. Simmer.
Fry the sausages and mushrooms in the extra oil until browned and stir into the gumbo for the last 10 minutes.
Cook the rice and serve the gumbo over it.

veg.make_ahead: Wrap the wellington up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms, onion and garlic in the butter until dry and dark, stir in the walnuts, spinach, salt and pepper and cool.
Overlap the pastry sheets, spoon the mushroom mix along the middle, roll up, seal the ends and brush with one beaten egg.
Roast the potatoes in the olive oil at 220C.
Bake the wellington at 200C until deep golden.
Whisk the remaining eggs, flour and milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C.
Whisk the gravy flour into the stock and soy sauce and simmer until thick.

veg.n: Mum's chickpea, broccoli and rice bake
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, bake fresh

steps.text: Fry the chickpeas in the oil until a little crisp.
Spread the rice in a baking dish, add the chickpeas and broccoli, then pour over the hot stock mixed with the cream.
Cover and bake at 180C.
Top with cheddar and bake uncovered until golden.

veg.make_ahead: Eat straight away

steps.text: Slice the garlic and mushrooms and chop the parsley.
Cook the linguine in salted water until al dente.
Toast the panko in a spoon of the oil until golden.
Heat the butter and the rest of the oil, fry the mushrooms until golden, then add the garlic and chilli flakes for a minute.
Add the wine and bubble.
Toss in the drained pasta with a splash of pasta water, lemon zest and juice and the parsley.
Top with the crumbs.
Slice the garlic and mushrooms and chop the parsley.
Cook the linguine in salted water until al dente.
Toast the panko in a spoon of the oil until golden.
Heat the butter and the rest of the oil, fry the mushrooms until golden, then add the garlic and chilli flakes for a minute.
Add the stock and vinegar and bubble.
Toss in the drained pasta with a splash of pasta water, lemon zest and juice and the parsley.
Top with the crumbs.

veg.make_ahead: Better the next day, keep chilled

steps.text: Peel and chop the onion, garlic, potatoes, cassava and plantain, and cut the corn into chunks.
Simmer the stock with the onion and garlic.
Add the corn, potatoes, cassava, plantain and chickpeas and simmer until thick.
Cook the rice while the soup simmers.
Finish with coriander and serve with rice and sliced avocado.

veg.n: Farva's double cheeseburgers with smoky mushrooms

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in half the oil with the smoked paprika until crisp at the edges.
Roll the plant-based mince into balls and smash flat on a very hot plate oiled with the rest of the oil, season and cook 2 minutes.
Flip, top each with cheddar and cook 1 minute.
Mix the mayo, the tomato sauce, the mustard and the chopped pickles.
Toast the burger buns, spread with sauce and stack the patties, mushrooms, pickles and diced onion in.

veg.make_ahead: Loaf up to 1 day, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Fry the onion and mushrooms in the oil until dry and cool slightly.
Roughly mash the lentils and mix with the mushrooms, breadcrumbs, eggs, soy sauce and salt.
Press into a lined loaf tin, spread with the tomato sauce and bake at 180C.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and cook the peas.
Rest the loaf 10 minutes and serve thick slices with mash and peas.
Fry the onion and mushrooms in the oil until dry and cool slightly.
Roughly mash the lentils and mix with the mushrooms, breadcrumbs, eggs, soy sauce and salt.
Press into a lined loaf tin, spread with the tomato sauce mixed with the brown sugar and bake at 180C.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and cook the peas.
Rest the loaf 10 minutes and serve thick slices with mash and peas.
Fry the onion and mushrooms in the oil until dry and cool slightly.
Roughly mash the lentils and mix with the mushrooms, breadcrumbs, eggs, soy sauce and salt.
Press into a lined loaf tin, spread with the tomato sauce mixed with the brown sugar and bake at 180C.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and cook the peas.
Rest the loaf 10 minutes and serve thick slices with mash and peas.

veg.n: Asgardian feast whole roast celeriac with roast roots

steps.text: Rub the celeriacs with half the oil, the salt and cracked pepper and wrap each in foil with half the butter and thyme.
Roast at 200C for 1 and a half hours.
Toss the carrots, parsnips and potatoes in the rest of the oil, unwrap the celeriacs and roast everything together, basting with the buttery juices.
Cut the celeriacs into wedges and serve on a big board with the roots and crusty bread.
Dice the onions and carrots.
Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil.
Soften the onions and carrots, return the mushrooms with the red wine, stock and lentils and simmer until thick.
Boil the potatoes and mash with plenty of butter.
Spoon the stew over the mash.
Dice the onions and carrots.
Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil.
Soften the onions and carrots, return the mushrooms with the stock, vinegar and lentils and simmer until thick.
Boil the potatoes and mash with plenty of butter.
Spoon the stew over the mash.
Press the dough into an oiled rectangular tin and prove for 30 minutes.
Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic into a sauce.
Cover the dough right to the edges with the cheeses and plant-based pepperoni.
Bake at 250C for 15 minutes.
Stripe the tomato sauce on top.

veg.n: Nora's last honey glazed smoked tofu

steps.text: Score the top of the smoked tofu blocks in a diamond pattern and stud with cloves.
Simmer the honey, sugar, mustard and pineapple juice until syrupy.
Roast the potatoes in the oil at 200C for 45 minutes. After 20 minutes, add the tofu in an oiled dish and brush with glaze every 5 minutes.
Toss the pineapple, chilli, mint and lime juice for the salsa.
Slice the tofu and serve with the potatoes and salsa.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheats well

steps.text: Slice the eggplants 1cm thick, brush with most of the oil and grill or fry until golden.
Fry the onion and mushrooms in the rest of the oil with the cinnamon until browned, add the lentils and tomatoes and simmer.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk until thick and beat in the egg off the heat.
Layer eggplant and lentil mix in a dish and pour over the bechamel.
Bake at 180C until golden.

veg.make_ahead: Better the next day

steps.text: Soften the diced onion, carrot and celery in the oil.
Add the mushrooms and brown hard.
Pour in the wine and reduce, then add the tomatoes, lentils, cheese rind and water.
Simmer gently for 1 and a half hours, topping up with water.
Cook the rigatoni and toss through the ragù with a splash of pasta water.
Grate the cheese over.

veg_af.n: Hanna's mushroom and lentil ragù (alcohol free)

steps.text: Soften the diced onion, carrot and celery in the oil.
Add the mushrooms and brown hard.
Pour in the stock and vinegar and reduce, then add the tomatoes, lentils, cheese rind and water.
Simmer gently for 1 and a half hours, topping up with water.
Cook the rigatoni and toss through the ragù with a splash of pasta water.
Grate the cheese over.
Tear the mushrooms into thick strips.
Toss with half the oil, the juice of the orange, crushed garlic, bay leaves and salt and roast at 220C, turning, until the edges crisp.
Char the tomatillos and chilli, then blitz with coriander.
Crisp the mushrooms in batches in a hot pan with the rest of the oil.
Warm the tortillas and serve with the mushrooms and salsa.

veg.n: Mother's Day smoked tofu and spinach frittata
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat gently or serve at room temperature

steps.text: Dice the potato, onion and smoked tofu and crumble the feta.
Boil the potato until tender, then drain.
Fry the onion and tofu in oil in an ovenproof pan, add the potato and spinach and stir until wilted.
Whisk the eggs with cream and salt, pour over and scatter with feta.
Cook on low heat until the edges set.
Bake at 180C until set and golden.
Serve with rocket dressed in lemon and relish.
Slice the onion and mushrooms.
Sear the mushrooms fast in batches in the oil until browned and set aside.
Soften the onion, add the paprika, Dijon and stock and reduce.
Boil the noodles and drain.
Stir in the sour cream off the heat and return the mushrooms. Serve over the noodles.
Slice the onion into rings and soak in the milk.
Dredge in flour and fry in the oil into rings.
Fry the mushrooms in a spoon of the oil with the smoked paprika until crisp at the edges.
Smash eight patties from the plant-based mince on a hot oiled griddle and top with cheese.
Stack two per toasted bun with mushrooms, onion rings and barbecue sauce.

ingredients.item: butternut pumpkin, cut into thick wedges

steps.text: Rub the pumpkin wedges with the oil, smoked paprika, pepper and salt.
Roast at 200C until tender with a dark crust.
Rest the pumpkin.
Char the corn cobs on a hot grill, turning.
Shred the cabbage and grate the carrot, then mix with the mayonnaise and vinegar for a crunchy coleslaw.
Toss the haloumi in the oil, the juice of two limes, crushed garlic and chopped chilli.
Leave to marinate.
Cook the rice and warm the drained beans.
Grill the haloumi until charred on both sides.
Make a salsa of diced tomato, red onion, the last lime and salt.

veg.make_ahead: Beetroot up to 2 days ahead, assemble fresh

steps.text: Wrap the beetroots in foil with the oil, salt and pepper.
Roast at 200C until tender.
Cool, rub off the skins and slice thin.
Fill the rolls with beetroot, horseradish cream and a handful of rocket each.

veg.n: Portobello steaks with onion gravy and mash

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with most of the butter and the milk.
Cook the onions in the rest of the butter until deep golden, stir in the flour, then add the stock and soy and simmer.
Brush the mushrooms with the oil and sear hard in a smoking pan, turning once, until tender.
Pour the gravy over the mushrooms.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Stir the flour into the oil over medium heat until it turns dark brown.
Add the onion, capsicum and celery and soften.
Add the sausages, kidney beans, okra and stock and simmer until rich and thick.
Cook the rice and serve the gumbo over it.

veg.n: Meaty Boy mushroom and haloumi burgers
veg.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Brush the mushrooms with the oil and season with salt and pepper.
Fry the mushrooms until tender, frying the haloumi alongside, and add a slice of cheese to each mushroom at the end.
Toast the buns and build with lettuce, tomato, beetroot, the mushroom, haloumi and tomato sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil in a heavy pot.
Add the onions, carrots and paprika and stir for a few minutes.
Pour in the stout and stock and add the lentils.
Simmer gently until thick.
Serve in big bowls with crusty bread.
Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil in a heavy pot.
Add the onions, carrots and paprika and stir for a few minutes.
Pour in the stock, malt vinegar and soy sauce and add the lentils.
Simmer gently until thick.
Serve in big bowls with crusty bread.

veg.n: Utah's mushroom and ricotta meatball subs

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in a little of the oil until dry and cool.
Mix with the ricotta, egg, breadcrumbs, cheese and salt, roll into meatballs and chill.
Brown the meatballs gently in the rest of the oil.
Simmer in the passata with crushed garlic.
Pack into the rolls, top with provolone and grill until melted.

ingredients.item: lemons, 1 zested and juiced, 1 in wedges

steps.text: Mix the panko with parsley, lemon zest and oil.
Pat the tofu dry, salt it, spread the tops with Dijon, press on the crumb and roast at 200C.
Steam the beans.
Melt the butter with the lemon juice and spoon over everything. Serve with lemon wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Best eaten straight away

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips, rinse and dry well. Whisk the batter flour, cornflour and cold lager together.
Fry the chips in oil at 140C until pale and soft, then drain.
Cook the peas, then crush with the butter and chopped mint and keep warm.
Dust the haloumi in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C in batches until golden and crisp.
Fry the chips again at 185C until crisp. Salt well and serve with the haloumi, peas and malt vinegar.
Cut the potatoes into chips, rinse and dry well. Whisk the batter flour, cornflour and cold soda water together.
Fry the chips in oil at 140C until pale and soft, then drain.
Cook the peas, then crush with the butter and chopped mint and keep warm.
Dust the haloumi in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C in batches until golden and crisp.
Fry the chips again at 185C until crisp. Salt well and serve with the haloumi, peas and malt vinegar.

veg.n: Tiana's Palace Cajun mushrooms and grits

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms and spring onions.
Simmer the polenta in the water, stirring, until thick.
Beat the cheddar and butter into the polenta.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil with the smoked paprika until browned and crisp at the edges.
Add the garlic and Cajun seasoning and cook for a minute.
Spoon over the polenta and scatter with spring onion.

veg.n: Beach house barbecue tofu and corn

steps.text: Press the tofu dry, cut into thick slabs and brush with the oil.
Grill the tofu and corn over coals until charred.
Brush the tofu with barbecue sauce in the last minutes.
Mix the cabbage with the mayo for slaw.
Serve with soft rolls.
